title: Telecommunications Engineer (Istanbul - Hybrid)
desc:
AXON Networks delivers a robust AI-driven, analytics-based orchestration platform and a wide portfolio of next-gen high-speed routers that leverage the newest Wi-Fi technologies. Together, these technologies give ISPs the ability to manage and troubleshoot their networks in real time, and to deliver an outstanding customer experience.
AXON Networks is a trusted strategic partner for its customers, helping them evaluate their current technologies and business models, and creating and executing strategies that enable them to innovate faster, accelerate their digital transformations, and strengthen their relationships with consumers.
AXON Networks is headquartered in Irvine, CA USA with Asia HQ in Singapore and also operating in Denmark, Spain and Vietnam.
AXON Networks is looking for a Telecommunications Algorithms Engineer to join our team as an Algorithms & Data Analyst Developer. You’ll work on cutting-edge solutions for global ISPs like DT, Telefónica, and Bouygues, improving access networks, WiFi management, and E2E software.
The Telecommunications Algorithms Engineer plays a key role in the design and development of AXON Networks products focused on access and WiFi technologies. You'll leverage your technical expertise in algorithms and PON/WiFi systems throughout the entire release process, including data analysis, algorithm definition, documentation, implementation, testing, and bug fixing.
You will be working in a dynamic and continuous learning environment, with highly cooperative colleagues, and you will feel a part of a highly skilled technical community.
Responsibilities
Provide expert support for AXON Networks product features.
Design, develop, and refine algorithms, including troubleshooting and bug fixing.
Drive innovation in managing access networks, setting the direction for next-generation software solutions for network access technologies.
Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of excellence and collaboration.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver transformative products that meet the needs of global ISPs.
Requirements
Technical Skills
Master’s in Telecommunications or related field (PhD is a plus).
Experience working on physical layer of communication systems.
Knowledge of communication systems and statistical processing.
Knowledge of copper (DSL), fiber (PON) or Wi-Fi technologies is desirable.
Experience in collection, tests definition, analysis, reporting of data, etc. in lab/production environments.
Experience with database languages such as SQL/mongodb.
Experience in control version systems, as GIT.
Experience in Java software development.
Experience in algorithm analysis
Familiarity with Linux (as user) as well as programming in scripting languages like Python.
Familiarity with data mining and machine learning algorithms
We look for different profiles so no need to meet all the technical skills.
Soft Skills.
Analytical Capabilities, Critical thinking, Problem solving, Eager to learn, and Proactive.
Planning and Organizational skills, Active listening, Communication skills.
Teamwork, autonomous.
Customer and results orientation.
Fluency in English.
Benefits
We offer competitive salaries based on USD.
Hybrid working setup depends on the project and will be discussed at interviews.
Only applications submitted in English will be reviewed or considered for this position.
